notes.title: Spoockey Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41459766/ea5ca9112acc11a520a30ca321b7b1b6c573943b.png[/img]

Hello Humans, Happy New Year! 

Well that does not matter … Happy Halloween 4 ever!

and to celebrate we have a new trailer and Updates :)

Since the release of Spoockey we have been working hard to bring you an update where changes were made to the game in search of a better experience.

[b]What's in the update?[/b]

[b]Visual/Sounds Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Menus and screens
[*] Controls can now be viewed before starting the game.
[*] Initial sequence updated
[*] Various visual effects (animations / particles) were improved and changed
[*] Visual bugs fixed
[*] Most sounds updated
[/list]
[b]Online:[/b]
[list]
[*] Experience improved for P2
[/list]
[b]Play:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted maps and collisions.
[/list]
Added a new control configuration to be able to move the puck and mirror at the same time.
When playing more than one game in a row, you no longer wait for the initial animation to finish to start the game.
We hope you enjoy the game and that if you have any questions or feedback that you want to share with us you can contact us through our community hub on Steam or [url=https://discord.gg/C2B4WRe]join our Discord[/url].

Thank you and have a Spoockey year!

notes.title: You can play Spoockey today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41459766/4f35f93e7a6a802121bae7aef91d2ecff4468e1c.png[/img]

Hello humans, welcome to the [b]Spoockey [/b] discussion forum. 
Here you can express yourself, meet other players, read about the development and why not leave your fan arts :)
 
Spoockey is the first game that we work with the new Hidden People Club team. The first approach was to start a project together that allows us to learn about new tools/tech and get to know ourselves. For us it is very important because this is the first brick (pun intended) of a larger construction that we will be working on during 2022.
 
But enough of Hidden People Club, we want you to play Spoockey and share it with your friends (It's free!!!), and tell us what you think.

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/C2B4WRe]Discord [/url] and have a Spoockey Day 🎃
